goal: Remove the redundant Thinking toggle from the Rayucode VS Code extension webview and add live thinking/working status indicators (Thinking... / Thought for Ns / Working...) without rendering full thinking text. Thinking is always on; effort level controls intensity.
stack: typescript, react, bun, browser-only webview bundle (target: browser). No Node/engine/CLI code.
flow: Webview is a pure view rebuilt from host `init` snapshot. Reducer in src/vscode/webview/state/reducer.ts is the single source of truth. Engine already sends thinking deltas (appendPartial kind:'thinking') but the reducer drops them — no protocol or host changes needed. Track ephemeral thinking metadata in the reducer; render a status indicator in the transcript. Duration measured client-side via Date.now() on first thinking delta -> first text delta.
constraints: Webview is browser-only: no Node APIs, no imports from src/utils or engine/CLI code
Webview state rebuilt from init — new state must live in ChatState (ephemeral UI state pattern, like workspaceFiles) or derivable from existing messages
src/vscode/shared/ is type-only and dependency-free — do not add value imports
DO NOT change CLI rendering — CLI thinking display stays as-is
Engine↔host protocol already sends thinking deltas — no protocol changes on that boundary
Do NOT accumulate or render full thinking text — status indicators only
copilot.css must contain ZERO hex literals — only --vscode-* tokens and local --rc-* sizing/spacing tokens
Reuse existing CSS classes/patterns where possible (rc-pulse-dot animation, rc-pill, rc-turn)
setThinking message type and host handler stay in place (harmless) — just stop invoking from UI

frontend.name: thinking-status
frontend.task: Remove Thinking toggle; add live Thinking/Thought-for-Ns/Working indicator; track thinking metadata in reducer; tidy input bar
